experiment: Human Cell Atlas immune unfamiliar-material acquisition v0.1

source.projectTitle: Cross-tissue immune cell analysis reveals tissue-specific features in humans

provenance.verification: Official HCA Data Explorer project record checked before admission to specimen queue.
provenance.identityRule: For the selected public specimen, retain HCA project UUID, source filename/object identity, retrieval date, byte size, source-provided checksum when available, and locally computed content hash before five-organ ingestion.

boundedSamplePolicy.reason: The project contains hundreds of sequencing files and multiple matrices; Level-1 requires one bounded public specimen before any bulk acquisition.
selectionRequirements: select one openly downloadable processed matrix or metadata-bearing object rather than managed-access material
prefer a specimen that preserves cell-to-donor, cell-to-tissue, cell-type or receptor/clone relations without assuming these are graph edges
retain project UUID, file identity and experiment context
record deterministic extraction or sampling rule
do not pre-label self/non-self, tolerance, exclusion or distributed immunity as lessons for ZENOMORPH

blindIngestionInstruction: Treat this as unfamiliar external material. Inspect and metabolize it under existing organ rules.
forbiddenHints: Do not tell organs that immune-system organization should be copied into ZENOMORPH.
Do not equate cell annotation, tissue membership, clonotype, receptor sequence or sample provenance with network edges unless the specimen explicitly supports that relation type.
Do not predeclare self/non-self, tolerance, exclusion, memory or decentralization as the lesson.
organRoute: DROPLET: bind project/version/license and acquire one bounded public specimen
MUTHER: read/decompose/recombine observations without supplied analogy
GUT: classify absorbable relation types, uncertainty, waste and candidate metabolic effect
VAJRA: attack category-to-edge collapse, biological analogy and provenance leakage
SHROOMING: expose downstream interpretation only after upstream effects exist

crossFoodRole.urbanCounterexample: A street feature without actual node relations remains structurally empty; HCA labels likewise cannot earn graph-edge status by name alone.
crossFoodRole.maleCNSCounterexample: MaleCNS SWC parent-child relations are explicit geometry/topology; HCA cell annotations and tissue membership may be relations of a different type and must not be collapsed into the same edge semantics.
crossFoodRole.physarumCounterexample: Time-varying transport geometry and single-cell atlas relations are heterogeneous; persistence or biological naming is not enough to normalize them into one network representation.

nextGate: Acquire and hash one bounded openly downloadable HCA immune specimen, type its relations without graph-edge collapse, then run the five-organ path and cross-food regression before any structural candidate can enter isolated morphogenesis.
